project.name: xmdtest PROFESSOR XMD dashboard
project.summary: The CEO's live control dashboard for the AI engineering company: start a project conversation, watch the board of agents discuss, follow the XMD Computer, read reports. Must work on a phone.

milestones.title: Dashboard shell — header, board view, mobile navigation

ledger.decision_summary: Header on top; conversation/board in the main area; on mobile a bottom navigation bar. Every interactive control ≥44×44 px. Text contrast ≥4.5:1 (WCAG AA). No horizontal overflow at 375/768/1280.
Calm, professional, dense-but-readable UI; one consistent type scale; icons with accessible labels.

miniReports.title: Dashboard shell & accessibility
miniReports.detail: DECISION: header + main board + mobile bottom nav. CONSTRAINTS: touch targets ≥44px, WCAG AA contrast, no overflow. TRADE-OFF: bigger controls take space on mobile, accepted for usability.

miniReports.title: Visual language
miniReports.detail: DECISION: calm professional look, consistent type scale, labelled icons. CONSTRAINTS: none beyond AA. TRADE-OFF: less decoration, more clarity.
